items.name: SinkContextKind
items.summary: The type of context reported by a searcher.

items.name: SinkContext
items.summary: A type that describes a contextual line reported by a searcher.

methods.name: absolute_byte_offset
methods.summary: Returns the absolute byte offset of the start of this context. This offset is absolute in that it is relative to the very beginning of the input in a search, and can never be relied upon to be a valid index into an in-memory slice.

methods.name: bytes
methods.summary: Returns the context bytes, including line terminators.

methods.name: kind
methods.summary: Returns the type of context.

methods.name: line_number
methods.summary: Returns the line number of the first line in this context, if available.

items.name: SinkFinish
items.summary: Summary data reported at the end of a search.

methods.name: binary_byte_offset
methods.summary: If binary detection is enabled and if binary data was found, then this returns the absolute byte offset of the first detected byte of binary data.

methods.name: byte_count
methods.summary: Return the total number of bytes searched.

items.name: SinkMatch
items.summary: A type that describes a match reported by a searcher.

methods.name: absolute_byte_offset
methods.summary: Returns the absolute byte offset of the start of this match. This offset is absolute in that it is relative to the very beginning of the input in a search, and can never be relied upon to be a valid index into an in-memory slice.

methods.name: buffer
methods.summary: Exposes as much of the underlying buffer that was search as possible.

methods.name: bytes
methods.summary: Returns the bytes for all matching lines, including the line terminators, if they exist.

methods.name: bytes_range_in_buffer
methods.summary: Returns a range that corresponds to where [`SinkMatch::bytes`] appears in [`SinkMatch::buffer`].

methods.name: line_number
methods.summary: Returns the line number of the first line in this match, if available.

methods.name: lines
methods.summary: Return an iterator over the lines in this match.

items.name: Sink
items.summary: A trait that defines how results from searchers are handled.

methods.name: begin
methods.summary: This method is called when a search has begun, before any search is executed. By default, this does nothing.

methods.name: binary_data
methods.signature: fn binary_data(&mut self, _searcher: &Searcher, _binary_byte_offset: u64) -> Result<bool, Self::Error>
methods.summary: This method is called whenever binary detection is enabled and binary data is found. If binary data is found, then this is called at least once for the first occurrence with the absolute byte offset at which the binary data begins.

methods.name: context
methods.summary: This method is called whenever a context line is found, and is optional to implement. By default, it does nothing and returns `true`.

methods.name: context_break
methods.summary: This method is called whenever a break in contextual lines is found, and is optional to implement. By default, it does nothing and returns `true`.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: This method is called when a search has completed. By default, this does nothing.

methods.name: matched
methods.summary: This method is called whenever a match is found.

items.name: SinkError
items.summary: A trait that describes errors that can be reported by searchers and implementations of `Sink`.

methods.name: error_config
methods.summary: A constructor for converting configuration errors that occur while building a searcher into an error of this type.

methods.name: error_io
methods.summary: A constructor for converting I/O errors that occur while searching into an error of this type.

methods.name: error_message
methods.summary: A constructor for converting any value that satisfies the `std::fmt::Display` trait into an error.
